lead.title: Zealand Pharma: petrelintide (partnered with Roche) meets its primary endpoint in Phase 2 ZUPREME-2, up to 9.2% weight loss at 28 weeks
lead.deck: In 220 overweight or obese participants with type 2 diabetes, all three doses beat placebo (up to 9.2% vs 2%), with HbA1c down by up to 0.65 points vs a 0.23-point rise on placebo, and 1.9% GI discontinuations vs 1.7%. Shares still fell about 4%: the market wanted more from a crowded amylin analog field.

milestone.title: Alligator Bioscience ends in-house development of mitazalimab and makes CFO Johan Giléus CEO from January 1, 2027
milestone.summary: Johan Giléus succeeds Søren Bregenholt while keeping the CFO role; the Swedish biotech refocuses on its interest in HLX22, a HER2-targeting antibody.
milestone.why: A slimmed-down leadership and an in-house pipeline dropped in favour of a shared asset: the typical pattern of a listed biotech preserving cash in a capital-scarce market.

brefsEurope.title: Newron aims to lift the FDA hold on ENIGMA-TRS 2 by screening for Brugada syndrome and cutting US enrolment to 60-80 patients
brefsEurope.summary: An amendment is expected within 10-12 days, with the FDA then having 30 days to respond; five deaths are recorded across evenamide studies (four on drug, one on placebo). ENIGMA-TRS 1, unaffected, reports in Q1 2027.

brefsEurope.title: Spica Therapeutics names Jeff Abbey CEO, formerly head of RNatives
brefsEurope.summary: Spica plans to extend its macrophage-targeting platform into inflammation and fibrosis.

brefsEurope.title: Sensorion names Lou Arcudi CFO, ex-Amolyt Pharma, ahead of a SENS-601 trial planned for early 2027
brefsEurope.summary: The company confidentially filed in September for a potential US listing; Lou Arcudi succeeds Laurene Danon.

brefsEurope.title: RQ Bio hires Gavin Koh as Chief Medical Officer after its $115M Series A
brefsEurope.summary: The biotech is developing RQB01, a long-acting influenza antibody; the hire comes with additions in manufacturing and clinical operations.

brefsIntl.title: KymaThera raises $80M Series B led by Alta Partners for its PI3Kα inhibitor K-1728
brefsIntl.summary: Foresite Capital and Venrock participate; Phase I dosing is planned for Q4 2026 in HR+/HER2- breast cancer and PI3Kα-driven vascular malformations. A valuation comparable for European precision-oncology biotechs.

word.definition: An injectable or oral drug that mimics amylin, a pancreatic hormone that slows stomach emptying and signals fullness, to drive weight loss with the aim of fewer GI side effects than GLP-1s.

how.t: The peptide binds amylin receptors in the brain.
The fullness signal rises and gastric emptying slows.
Patients eat less; in ZUPREME-2, up to 9.2% weight loss at 28 weeks.

word.why: After GLP-1s, amylin is the hot route: Roche paid $1.65B upfront to Zealand and AbbVie entered obesity through Gubra. For a VC the question is who stays independent, as several players have already been acquired.

startups.name: Zealand Pharma
startups.use: Petrelintide, an amylin analog co-developed with Roche; positive Phase 2 ZUPREME-2 in October 2026

startups.name: Gubra
startups.use: ABBV-295, a long-acting amylin analog licensed to AbbVie ($350M upfront); $50M milestone on Phase 2 start

startups.name: Verdiva Bio
startups.use: VRB-103, a once-weekly oral amylin analog, clinic entry expected H2 2026; $411M raised at launch in January 2025
